templates.title: Garbage Record Book (Part I all ships / Part II solid bulk cargo residues)
templates.regulation_basis: MARPOL Annex V regulation 10 and appendix II (form of Garbage Record Book) as amended by MEPC.314(74)
templates.verification_note: Transcribed from a shipowner GRB Part I form reproducing appendix II; verify against MARPOL Annex V appendix II (MEPC.314(74)). Polar Code chapter 5 part II-A references retained.

operation_codes.title: Discharge to a reception facility ashore or to other ships

items.text: Date and time of discharge
Port or facility, or name of ship
Categories of garbage discharged
Estimated amount discharged for each category in cubic metres
Signature of officer in charge of the operation

operation_codes.title: Incineration

items.text: Date and time of start and stop of incineration
Position of the ship (latitude and longitude) at the start and stop of incineration
Categories of garbage incinerated
Estimated amount incinerated in cubic metres
Signature of the officer in charge of the operation

operation_codes.note: Incineration of certain categories is prohibited by Annex VI reg. 16; 'in ports, harbours and estuaries' needs port polygons.

operation_codes.title: Discharge into the sea (regulations 4, 5 or 6 / Polar Code part II-A ch. 5)

items.text: Date and time of discharge
Position of the ship (latitude and longitude); for cargo residue discharges, start and stop positions
Category of garbage discharged
Estimated amount discharged for each category in cubic metres
Signature of the officer in charge of the operation

operation_codes.title: Accidental or other exceptional discharge or loss into the sea (regulation 7)

items.text: Date and time of occurrence
Port or position of the ship at time of occurrence (latitude, longitude and water depth if known)
Categories of garbage discharged or lost
Estimated amount for each category in cubic metres
The reason for the discharge or loss and general remarks

operation_codes.note: Reason text is mandatory; missing reason → form warning.

templates.summary_table_1: Appendix II Table 1 (summary): outside SA – food waste comminuted ≥3 nm en route, not comminuted ≥12 nm; cargo residues (non-HME) ≥12 nm en route; cleaning agents permitted if non-HME; carcasses en route as far as possible (>100 nm, max depth); all other garbage prohibited. Inside SA/Arctic – food waste comminuted ≥12 nm en route, not comminuted prohibited; cargo residues only in washwater ≥12 nm subject to reg. 6.1.2; deck washwater cleaning agents permitted; carcasses prohibited. Mixed garbage → more stringent requirement. Avian products in Antarctic not permitted unless sterile.
